literal_meaning: ভালো করে তোলা বা সুস্থ করা
figurative_meaning_en: To cure someone of an illness through medical treatment
example_sentences_in_bangla: ডাক্তার তার জ্বর ভালো করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The mother nursed her son back to health.
note: This idiom is commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to refer to recovery from illness, reflecting traditional views on healing.
